servicesIndex.title: Services — CNC Milling, Turning, Grinding | RUDA Orodjarstvo
servicesIndex.description: CNC milling, turning and grinding of high-precision components. Hard materials up to 65 HRC, carbide (WIDIA), 5-axis milling. Spodnja Idrija, Slovenia.
servicesIndex.heading: Services
servicesIndex.intro: Three core services from one workshop: CNC milling, turning, and precision grinding. RUDA Orodjarstvo specialises in hard materials and carbide (WIDIA).

milling.title: Milling (5-axis CNC, up to 65 HRC) — RUDA Orodjarstvo
milling.description: 5-axis CNC milling of all materials, including hard steels up to 65 HRC and carbide (WIDIA). One-offs, prototypes, small to medium batches. Slovenia.
milling.lead: 5-axis CNC milling of all materials, including hardened tool steels up to 65 HRC and carbide (WIDIA). One-offs, prototypes, and small to medium batch production.
what: 5-axis milling of all types of materials
Hard milling up to hardness 65 HRC
milling.materials: All standard tool steels (1.2080, 1.2363, 1.2379, 1.2767, K340), stainless steels, aluminium, copper, brass, hardened steel up to 65 HRC, and carbide (WIDIA). Tolerances per project requirements.
milling.applications: Stamping dies, injection moulds, forming tools, die-casting moulds, precision machine-building parts, micro-parts for medical and electronics, prototypes.

faq.q: What is the maximum hardness you can mill?
faq.a: Up to 65 HRC, including hardened tool steels and carbide (WIDIA).
Yes — all materials, including hard materials and carbide.

faq.q: Can you produce single prototypes or only batches?
faq.a: Both — one-offs, prototypes, and small to medium batches.
All standard tool steels, stainless, aluminium, carbide (WIDIA), and hard steels up to 65 HRC.
Spodnja Idrija, Slovenia. We ship across the EU.

turning.title: Turning — CNC, all materials — RUDA Orodjarstvo
turning.description: CNC turning of all types of materials. Prototyping and small to medium batch production. High precision. Slovenia.
turning.lead: CNC turning of all types of materials. Prototypes and small to medium batches with high precision and repeatable accuracy.
what: Turning of all types of materials
turning.materials: Structural and stainless steels, tool steels, aluminium, copper, brass, plastics. Diameters from micro-scale to typical machine-building parts.
turning.applications: Precision shafts, pins, bushings, punches, guides, components for stamping and injection-moulding tools, prototypes prior to series production.

faq.q: What precision do you achieve in turning?
faq.a: Tolerances are matched to project requirements, including micrometre ranges.
Yes — from single pieces to prototype runs.
All common structural, stainless, and tool steels, aluminium, copper, brass, and plastics.
Small to medium batches, often combined with milling and grinding.

grinding.title: Grinding — surface and 4-axis profile — RUDA Orodjarstvo
grinding.description: Surface grinding and 4-axis profile grinding. Precision components for stamping and forming processes. Slovenia.
grinding.lead: Surface grinding and 4-axis profile grinding for precision components. High-quality finishes and demanding geometries.
grinding.materials: Hardened tool steels, carbide (WIDIA), stainless steels. Typically for stamping and forming tools where fine surface finish and tight tolerances are required.
grinding.applications: Stamping plates, form inserts, guides, tool profile sides, final finishing of hardened components.

faq.q: What surface roughness do you achieve?
faq.a: Depending on requirements — we deliver finishes at the quality level the project demands.
Yes — 4-axis profile grinding for demanding geometries.
Hardened tool steels, carbide (WIDIA), and stainless steels.

faq.q: Do you combine grinding with other services?
faq.a: Yes — often as the final finishing step after milling of precision components.
